offering_description.value: Grindr operates a location-based dating and social networking app for gay, bisexual, transgender and other queer adults. It offers free and paid app features and sells in-app advertising to brands and agencies.

primary_services.value: Online dating and social networking; in-app advertising

customer_segment.value: B2C: Gay, bisexual, transgender and other queer adults; B2B: Brands and advertising agencies seeking to reach app users

end_markets.value: Online dating; social networking; digital advertising

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring access to premium discovery, messaging and browsing features; advertising: In-app ad placements and campaigns; transaction or usage fees: One-time purchases of profile visibility boosts
revenue_model.category: subscription; advertising; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Uses profiles and location data to connect adults and provide ad placements to marketers

geography_served.value: global: Users across the Americas, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Africa and the Middle East

specialization.value: niche specialist: Location-based dating and social networking for LGBTQ+ adults

distribution_channels.value: online: Apple App Store, Google Play and web access; direct sales: In-house sales to brands and advertising agencies; partners / resellers: Programmatic advertising partners

notes: Company size is assessed within LGBTQ+ dating and social networking.
